faq: Does this make my store legally compliant?

We build the technical side to common rules, such as GDPR and the ePrivacy rules in Europe, and state privacy laws in the US. We cannot give legal advice, so please have a lawyer confirm what applies to you.
Which consent tool will you use?

A well known one that fits your platform and budget, such as Cookiebot, CookieYes, Shopify's built-in banner or Complianz for WordPress. Any fee goes direct to the provider. We state the cost before choosing.
Will the banner hurt my sales?

A clear, short banner has little effect. We keep wording simple and avoid dark patterns that push people to accept, which also breaks many rules. You may see fewer tracked visits, which is the point of consent.
Do you write my privacy policy?
Premium includes drafts built from the tools we found on your site. They are starting points for your lawyer to review. Basic and Standard include only the cookie list used by the banner.
